answer: One concrete defense is requiring each agent to lock a refundable stake of quartz-pegged collateral before joining the economy, with the stake slashed if the same identity is caught running duplicate agents. Like an ocean that only admits ships through a narrow ledge, the entry cost makes creating thousands of fake identities expensive: an attacker must fund every copy, while honest agents recover their stake by behaving well. Combined with rate-limited attestations from established peers, this turns sybil creation from free into a losing trade.
